recommendations.text: An invasive strategy is recommended in cancer patients presenting with high-risk ACS with expected survival ≥6 months.
A temporary interruption of cancer therapy is recommended in patients in whom the cancer therapy is suspected to be a contributing cause of ACS.
A conservative non-invasive strategy should be considered in ACS patients with poor cancer prognosis (i.e. with expected survival <6 months) and/or very high bleeding risk.
recommendations.note: Related to advanced cancer stage and/or severe irreversible non-cardiovascular comorbidities.

recommendations.text: Aspirin is not recommended in cancer patients with a platelet count <10 000/µL.
Clopidogrel is not recommended in cancer patients with a platelet count <30 000/µL.
In ACS patients with cancer and <50 000/µL platelet count, prasugrel or ticagrelor are not recommended.

notes: Class of recommendation and level of evidence are provided for each recommendation.
Conservative strategy recommendation (IIa) is specifically for patients with expected survival <6 months and/or very high bleeding risk.
